title: Flow trycmd coverage: shape layouts, SVG/JSON/DOT structure, empty-store and cycle errors
description:
Finish the flow integration-test coverage started in 33a55c30 (closed as done 2026-10-06; the merged coverage and current flag surface are described there).

Open scenarios:
- Shape layout tests over the existing tests/workflows/flow-patterns.in stores (chain, diamond, disconnected, fan-in, fan-out, mixed): text layout layers, indicator glyphs, standalone sections, --show-done differences. The stores are built and load cleanly but no trycmd test references them yet.
- SVG generation: run --format svg -o out.svg and assert the file exists with the expected structure (column layout, status colors, critical-path classes with --goal).
- JSON export: validate the exported structure against docs/flow-json-schema.md, with --show-done and --goal.
- DOT export: assert digraph structure (nodes, edges, penwidth=2 on critical paths with --goal).
- Empty store: friendly 'nothing to show' message.
- Circular dependency: clear error message.

Keep tests fast (small fixture stores) and stable (pattern-match dynamic UUIDs).
